## Confucius on courage

Confucius (551–479 BCE) approaches courage within Confucianism. Confucius centers ren (humane concern), li (ritual propriety), and xiao (filial devotion) as interlocking practices that form character. Learning is lifelong self-cultivation, not mere technical skill; the junzi models integrity that others can follow. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets courage most directly—useful for searches such as “confucius quotes on courage.”
